run_benchmark_server: run the gRPC async benchmark server on localhost port 50051 with the BenchmarkServicer
start_async_server: start an async gRPC aio server that registers the BenchmarkService servicer and waits for termination
init_grpc_aio: initialize the gRPC aio event loop and run the benchmark server task forever
add_insecure_port: add an insecure port to the gRPC aio server for localhost communication on port 50051
register_benchmark_servicer: register the BenchmarkServicer to the gRPC aio server using add_BenchmarkServiceServicer_to_server
